title: Paid Media Impressions (Minimal)
description: Paid media impressions data with rule-driven derivations and explicit UID, metric, and supporting column separation.

pmi_safe_rules: When multiple rows exist for the same UID, sum impressions.
Do not split impressions across derived publishers.

publisher.description: Publisher name. Derived as 'total' when not available in source.

spends.description: Net paid media spend (incl. fees, excl. VAT).

impressions.description: Actual impressions delivered (raw counts, not in thousands).
